_metadata.description: District-level FSV multipliers applied to Sarkaari Mool(goverment assesed land value) to correct for systematic undervaluation.Sarkari Mool understates true market value by 3-5x in most districts.Multiplier calibrated from NRB concessional lending data and Nepal agrictultural cenus of 2021/2022
_metadata.source: Calibrated from NSO 2022, NRB Unified Directive 2081, author estimates
